entries.content_utf8:
import sys
import time

print("compiling", flush=True)
time.sleep(0.5)
print("linking", flush=True)
print(f"result {sys.argv[1]}", flush=True)
sys.exit(int(sys.argv[1]))

oracle_program:
run ["python3", "tools/build.py", "0"] background: true save_to: "logs/build-1.log"
jobs "j1" wait: 60s |> select exit_code |> write "logs/exit-1.txt"
reference_bash:
python3 tools/build.py 0 > logs/build-1.log 2>&1 &
pid=$!
wait $pid
echo $? > logs/exit-1.txt
